name: 23323 · Chesapeake, VA
findings: ZIP 23323 (Chesapeake) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23323 (Chesapeake) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23323 (Chesapeake) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
